headline: Cape Flares as Nevish Line Stirs Anew
war_summary: Since the 0300 edition the wires show Callum's Cape flaring to seven transfers in two hours, thirteen on the day about Naofa and Scouts Jest, now listing six Warden holdings and one ruin with heavy but cooling casualty rates, while the Nevish Line has stirred again with three in two hours to forty-five on the day about Grief Mother, Unruly and Mistle Shrine, all eight posts Colonial. Marban Hollow eased to two in two hours, eighteen on the day confined to Checkpoint Bua and divided two Warden, three Colonial and three ruins, and the Weathered Expanse logged one in two hours, thirty on the day across Crow's Nest, Huntsfort, Shattered Advance and Wightwalk for seven Warden holdings and two ruins. Linn Mercy added one in two hours, thirty-four on the day at Outwich Ranch and Rotdust for ten Colonial posts and one ruin, Mooring County stayed quiet on transfers with none in six hours, sixteen on the day at the Wind Hills for ten Warden and two Colonial posts amid sharply accelerating hourly losses, and Callahan's Passage recorded none in six hours, nineteen on the day at Crumbling Post under ten Warden posts.
